note: The minimal scored task set (P23). Five canonical tasks, each scored on five deterministic axes (routing, capabilities, modules, structure, emission); the 1.0 baseline per task is pinned by tests/test_scoreboard.py, so component-ablation (M5.12) can re-run these same tasks against a pruned configuration and compare on the same ground. The allowed/must values were taken from an actual classify+derive run on 2026-10-23, not written from memory (M0.4). A baseline change is a deliberate edit here, never a silent drift. P24 added the effect axis: every task declares its effect_metric (the machine-scorable metric for that task family) but stays unmeasured until a real run records a full {status: measured, score, judge, measured_on} receipt; the effect score never enters the structural total.

effect_axis.note: Structure and effect are different claims, so they are reported separately. effect_metric defines what a real run would measure per task; no score exists until one does (M0.4).
